title: Joseph McMoneagle's remote viewing of Soviet bases and the search for General Dozier

tellings.quote: Joseph mcmonagle mcmonagle used remote viewing to identify Soviet nuclear bases predict key critical events and he even helped locate kidnapped American General James doer

plain: A man named Joseph McMoneagle is said to have used remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe distant places or events with the mind alone, to find Soviet nuclear bases and predict critical events. Michels says McMoneagle also helped locate James Dozier, an American general who had been kidnapped in Italy. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a sign that the mind may reach beyond the senses.
